name: Impeccable

review: Review installer, detector and hooks. Do not enable unattended hooks without explicit approval.
Recheck upstream license, supported versions and exact source revision; inspect proposed changes before approval.

verify: Verify discovery and initialization; inspect generated PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md and any hook settings. Run a focused critique only after approval.

credibility.note: Stars and push date apply to the whole repository, not a particular skill. No independent quality score.
